{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdM6NaEBr5seEKq2sfrWF","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01HiKSQgB69X1g4grMbXDBMx","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/qa-quiz-004/2026-07-24T150846Z-claude-with-skill-1/workspace/answer.md","content":"# Mobile WalletConnect deep-linking on \"Stake\"\n\n## TL;DR\n\nTwo independent things happen when you sign on mobile WC: (a) the request is\n**published to the relay** so it queues inside the wallet, and (b) the browser\ntries to **foreground the wallet app**. (a) always works — that's why the\nrequest is \"waiting\" in Rainbow. (b) is what's broken. The fix is to publish\nfirst, then deep-link a beat later — never the reverse.\n\n---\n\n## (1) Why nothing auto-opened before the patch\n\nWhen your dApp is connected to Rainbow over **WalletConnect v2**, Rainbow is a\nseparate app. `writeContractAsync` does not talk to Rainbow directly; it hands\nan `eth_sendTransaction` request to the WalletConnect provider, which:\n\n1. serializes + encrypts the request and **publishes it to the WC relay\n   server** (a network round-trip). The wallet, subscribed to that topic,\n   receives it and shows the signing prompt. This is why, when the user\n   manually switches to Rainbow, the request is already sitting there — the\n   relay leg works fine.\n2. tries to **redirect the user to the wallet** so they actually see the\n   prompt. RainbowKit / WC does this using the wallet's redirect info stored on\n   the session (`session.peer.metadata.redirect.native` /\n   `.universal`), i.e. it opens the wallet's deep link.\n\nStep 2 is the flaky part, and it fails for a mobile-browser reason:\n\n- **Opening another app requires a live user activation (the tap).** iOS Safari\n  (and mobile Chrome) only let a page navigate to an external app scheme while a\n  \"transient user activation\" from the tap is still valid.\n- `writeContractAsync` is **async** — encrypt + publish to the relay is a\n  network round-trip. By the time WC is ready to redirect, the `await` has\n  already unwound the call stack and the tap's activation has been consumed /\n  expired. The browser then **silently refuses** to open the app.\n- (Secondary cause: if the connected wallet didn't populate `redirect` on its\n  session metadata, RainbowKit has no target to open and does nothing.)\n\nNet: request lands in the wallet, but the browser never brings the wallet\nforward, so the page \"just sits there.\"\n\n---\n\n## (2) Why the patch made it worse\n\n```js\nwindow.location.href = \"rainbow://\";   // line 1\nawait writeContractAsync(...);          // line 2\n```\n\nThis opens Rainbow **before the request exists**:\n\n- `window.location.href = \"rainbow://\"` fires immediately, before\n  `writeContractAsync` has built, encrypted, or published anything. Rainbow\n  comes forward with **nothing queued** → \"nothing to sign.\"\n- Worse, navigating away **backgrounds the web page**. Mobile browsers throttle\n  or suspend JS in a backgrounded tab, so the subsequent `writeContractAsync` —\n  the thing that publishes the request — may never run to completion. The relay\n  publish is paused/dropped, so the tx **never lands onchain**.\n\nSo the patch traded \"wallet doesn't open\" for \"wallet opens empty and the tx is\nnever sent\" — strictly worse.\n\n---\n\n## (3) The correct pattern\n\n**Order: publish first, deep-link second, with a short delay in between.**\n\n```js\nasync function onStake() {\n  // 1. Kick off the write — this triggers the WC relay publish.\n  const txPromise = writeContractAsync({ /* ... */ });\n\n  // 2. Give WC time to encrypt + publish to the relay, THEN foreground wallet.\n  if (shouldDeepLink()) {\n    setTimeout(() => {\n      window.location.href = getWalletRedirect(); // from session metadata\n    }, 200); // ~150–300ms\n  }\n\n  await txPromise;\n}\n```\n\n### The ordering and the delay\n\n- Start the write **first** so the request is actually created and pushed to the\n  relay. Do **not** `await` it before redirecting — you'd never open the wallet\n  in time. Fire the redirect on a short timer while the promise runs.\n- The delay exists to cover the **relay publish round-trip**: long enough that\n  by the time the wallet is foregrounded the request is already queued (too\n  short = empty wallet, same bug as the patch), but short enough to stay inside\n  the browser's transient-activation window (~5s on iOS) and feel instant. A\n  few hundred ms (~150–300ms) covers typical relay latency with margin.\n- Better than a fixed timer: redirect off the WC provider's own \"request sent\"\n  signal if you can hook it. The timer is the pragmatic version.\n- Best of all: prefer RainbowKit's **built-in** redirect handling (it already\n  knows the connected wallet and its links) over hand-rolling this. The manual\n  deep link is a fallback for when the automatic one doesn't fire.\n\n### Which scheme to open — do NOT hardcode `rainbow://`\n\n`connector.id === \"walletConnect\"` tells you only that the transport is\nWalletConnect, **not which wallet** the user picked. Hardcoding `rainbow://`\nbreaks MetaMask, Trust, etc. Read the target from the **active session's peer\nmetadata**:\n\n- `session.peer.metadata.redirect.universal` → prefer this (an https universal\n  link): it opens the app if installed and falls back to the App Store /\n  browser if not, and doesn't throw a scary \"open in app?\" prompt.\n- `session.peer.metadata.redirect.native` → the custom scheme\n  (`rainbow://`, `metamask://`, …), use as fallback.\n- `session.peer.metadata.name` identifies the wallet if you need to branch.\n\nIf no redirect metadata is present, don't guess a scheme — let RainbowKit handle\nit or leave the user to switch manually.\n\n### When to skip the deep link entirely\n\n- **Not mobile** — desktop browser: nothing to open; a scheme navigation errors\n  or no-ops.\n- **Injected / extension connector** (`connector.id !== \"walletConnect\"`, e.g.\n  injected MetaMask, Coinbase) — the wallet lives in-page; no app to foreground.\n- **Inside a wallet's in-app dApp browser** (already running in Rainbow /\n  MetaMask browser) — an injected provider is present; deep-linking would bounce\n  you out or loop.\n- **Desktop WC via QR** — the approval happens on the user's phone; the desktop\n  page has no app to open.\n- **No active WC session / no redirect metadata** — no valid target to open.\n\nGuard the redirect on: mobile device **and** `connector.id === \"walletConnect\"`\n**and** no injected provider in-page **and** a redirect target exists.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":5645,"cache_read_input_tokens":15147,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":5645},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"39ad3ee2-67c8-4541-ae27-e3201abbda2d","uuid":"c28c7b01-20d5-4e67-8aca-f862784b8b6e","timestamp":"2026-07-24T15:10:14.570Z","request_id":"req_011CdM6NU3s45rnb1WmXeMLA"}

Give WC time to encrypt + publish to the relay, THEN foreground wallet.\n  if (shouldDeepLink()) {\n    setTimeout(() => {\n      window.location.href = getWalletRedirect(); // from session metadata\n    }, 200); // ~150–300ms\n  }\n\n  await txPromise;\n}\n```\n\n### The ordering and the delay\n\n- Start the write **first** so the request is actually created and pushed to the\n  relay. Hardcoding `rainbow://`\nbreaks MetaMask, Trust, etc. Read the target from the **active session's peer\nmetadata**:\n\n- `session.peer.metadata.redirect.universal` → prefer this (an https universal\n  link): it opens the app if installed and falls back to the App Store /\n  browser if not, and doesn't throw a scary \"open in app?\" prompt.\n- `session.peer.metadata.redirect.native` → the custom scheme\n  (`rainbow://`, `metamask://`, …), use as fallback.\n- `session.peer.metadata.name` identifies the wallet if you need to branch.\n\nIf no redirect metadata is present, don't guess a scheme — let RainbowKit handle\nit or leave the user to switch manually.\n\n### When to skip the deep link entirely\n\n- **Not mobile** — desktop browser: nothing to open; a scheme navigation errors\n  or no-ops.\n- **Injected / extension connector** (`connector.id !== \"walletConnect\"`, e.g.\n  injected MetaMask, Coinbase) — the wallet lives in-page; no app to foreground.\n- **Inside a wallet's in-app dApp browser** (already running in Rainbow /\n  MetaMask browser) — an injected provider is present; deep-linking would bounce\n  you out or loop.\n- **Desktop WC via QR** — the approval happens on the user's phone; the desktop\n  page has no app to open.\n- **No active WC session / no redirect metadata** — no valid target to open.\n\nGuard the redirect on: mobile device **and** `connector.id === \"walletConnect\"`\n**and** no injected provider in-page **and** a redirect target exists.\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

Don't hardcode `rainbow://` — `connector.id` only says \"walletConnect\", not which wallet; read the target from `session.peer.metadata.redirect` (prefer the `universal` https link, fall back to `native` scheme).
